what: Label inside the panel (data-cursor="Unfold") — when it is over an element carrying it, a 64px diameter background-color circle holding that text turns on from .8x to 1x in .3s power2.out and hides the system cursor. Even when off, the circle follows the mouse with a lag at .8s expo.out, and when it moves over data-cursor-hide or off the label, it turns off the same way

options.--fx-disc·--fx-on: Circle color · text color, default var(--kf-bg)·var(--kf-ink)
options.[data-cursor]: Element in the panel that lights the circle, and its text
options.[data-cursor-hide]: Over it, a circle is dragged (play button, etc.)
options.from: Start scale when turning on, default .8 — at 1 it is opacity only with no size change (Brand)
options.fadeEase: Curve for turning on and off, default power2.out
options.cursor: With keep, the system cursor isn’t hidden even when the circle is on (photo-mosaic-pet-goods-shop: the original circle only turns off pointer-events and leaves the arrow as is)

note: Do not trigger on touch presses (pointerType touch) — so no circle is left under the finger. Follow only for mouse.
